en.description:
Play classic Ludo on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch—anytime and completely offline.

Choose Solo mode to play Red against the device, or start a Local match and pass one iPhone or iPad between friends. Pick a quick 2-player game or bring all four colors to the board in a 4-player match.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Solo mode against the device
• Local pass-and-play for 2 or 4 players
• A dedicated Apple Watch experience
• No account or internet connection required

CLASSIC LUDO RULES
Roll the dice, move your pawns, capture opponents, use safe squares, and race all four pawns to the center goal. Roll a six to bring a pawn onto the board and earn another turn after a six, capture, or finished pawn.

DESIGNED FOR QUICK PLAY
• Automatic game saving
• Resume your last match anytime
• Clear turn indicators and highlighted legal moves
• Sound effects, haptics, and button feedback
• Touch Assist for easier pawn selection
• Responsive layouts for iPhone and iPad

Whether you want a solo board game, a family pass-and-play match, or Ludo on your wrist, Ludo For Watch keeps the classic experience simple, colorful, and ready to play.
en.releaseNotes:
Version 1.1 brings the complete Ludo game to iPhone and iPad alongside Apple Watch.

• Play Solo against the device
• Start local 2-player or 4-player pass-and-play matches
• Automatically save and resume your game
• Enjoy refined layouts, clearer controls, and improved sound, haptics, and Touch Assist
• Includes reliability fixes and visual improvements
en.subtitle: Offline Solo & Local Play
